profile.description: ThirstyFest is a volunteer-led craft beer fundraiser benefiting Water For People. Current public material still centers on the 2025 event and does not show a current 2026 festival date. The event format is not a strong Adventure Zone inflatable-carnival fit.

notes.subject: 2026 review — stale / non-fit
notes.body: Adventure Zone emailed ThirstyFest in 2023 and 2024 with no reply found. Current public material still presents the Sept. 6, 2025 event, not a confirmed 2026 festival date. ThirstyFest is primarily a craft beer fundraiser with brewery tastings, music and food trucks; 2025 general admission was 21+ for unlimited tastings, with a separate designated-driver/under-21 ticket. Do not create routine inflatable-carnival outreach or follow-up unless the event materially changes format.
